title: Sensor fault isolates one channel (controller TC08, synthetic)
purpose: CH3 sensor B becomes unreadable at 120 s: only CH3 is switched off (303) and CHANNEL_FAULT is raised; a RESET at 150 s with the sensor still open is refused; the sensor recovers at 200 s but the latch holds until the RESET at 240 s.
data_source: Controller: Suchita's supervisory controller test TC08 (SIMULATED test bench, controller/neram_ctrl). Twin fields: test-bench stand-in values the controller received (SIMULATED).
loop_description: Open loop: synthetic below-hypo twin input, no patient plant.
limitations: The NaN on CH3 sensor B is an injected test fault.

Controller: Suchita's supervisory controller design (v2 specification); Python fallback code rebuilt by Sai on 18 Oct 2026 from that specification (reproduces her v2 logs byte for byte). Not a Simulink/Stateflow model.

Twin fields are test-bench stand-ins (synthetic inputs or a first-order filter stand-in), NOT the NERAM twin. The forecast is the stand-in's flat persistence (T_pred = T_est) with normal bands from T_est_sd.
Hardware signals and module temperatures come from test stand-ins; no hardware exists. Thresholds are placeholders (Shreehan, TBD).
No clinical, hardware or treatment claim is made.
